limitations: This review covers semantic correctness only. Calibration now has one exact-head pass and one exact-head failure on identical reviewed answers, so performance remains unstable and is not a calibrated claim.
Build 34 explicitly records zero official T2 distinct-head passing streak. Snapshot acceptance here applies only to reviewed answer content; it is not official T2 green.
